notes: ἐμβλέψασα αὐτῷ -> 'she looked upon him' gave 'upon' to the verb as its ἐν- element, against the identical shape at 14.65 (ἐμπτύειν αὐτῷ -> 'to spit' / 'on him'), which is another ἐν-compound with a dative pronoun. Rules 21 and 36 put the case preposition on the pronoun. Moved 'upon' to αὐτῷ.
